crossRefs.note: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah…
The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh…
But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but…
Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and…
There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all…

parallels.note: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but…

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Son of Machir; grandson of Manasseh; father of six sons.

people.name: Hepher
people.line: Son of Gilead, ancestor of the Hepherites.

people.name: Hoglah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, of the tribe of Manasseh.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Machir
people.line: Son of Manasseh; father (ie re-founder) of Gilead

people.name: Mahlah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, who received an inheritance among her brothers.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Milcah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, a descendant of Manasseh.

people.name: Tirzah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, granted inheritance rights

people.name: Zelophehad
people.line: Israelite whose daughters received his inheritance

translations.web: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
translations.bsb: Now the daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. These were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. They approached
translations.kjv: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
translations.asv: Then drew near the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
